notes.title: Verlet Ascend 2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have a small update that addresses some feedback and issues that we got from the release of 2.0. We hope that you are enjoying the 2.0 content.

Changes In this version;

-Made the first level shorter.
-Throwing knifes now aim and move towards enemies.
-Boss scene deadzone start speed increased.
-Forager upgrade spawns more carrots.
-Fixed most of the inconsistencies on terrain destruction.
-Less levels to complete the game.
-It is now easier to unlock new upgrades.

Please feel free to share with us your thoughts, ideas or if you face any bugs in Steam Community Forums  or as a reply to this post. Thank you!

notes.title: Verlet Ascend 2.0 is HERE!
notes.content:
Here is a list of changes for Verlet Ascend 2.0;

[h3][u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u][/h3]

[h3][b]Improved Character Animations:[/b][/h3]
- Sword IK polish.
- Rope grabbing + Shotgun animation aim set.
- Fixed head aim direction during jumps.
- Enhanced proc animation tool.
- Arm IK setup.
- Player character animation rigging.

[h3][b]New Enemy Types:[/b][/h3]
- Introduced Spider, Bat, Rat, and Verminator enemies.

[h3][b]Boss Fight:[/b][/h3]
- Added an exciting new boss battle with unique mechanics.

[h3][b]Daily Challenges:[/b][/h3]
- Implemented daily seed challenges for added variety.

[h3][u][b]Technical Improvements:[/b][/u][/h3]

[h3][b]Performance Optimization:[/b][/h3]
- Unity physics multi-threading.
- Project refactoring and physics performance improvements.
- Cloud rendering optimization.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
- Fixed controller-related issues.
- Resolved animation behavior issues.
- Ragdoll and animation fixes.
- Addressed sound and visual effect bugs.
- UI and camera corrections.
- Crosshair improvements.
- Perk unlockable screen fixes.
- Level design tweaks.

[h3][u][b]User Interface and Visual Enhancements:[/b][/u][/h3]

[h3][b]UI Polish:[/b][/h3]
- Improved UI elements, color palettes, and texture updates.
- Enhanced scrollbar visibility.
- Updated UI sound effects.

[h3][b]Game Icons:[/b][/h3]
- Added anti-aliased game icons for a polished look.

[h3][u][b]Miscellaneous:[/b][/u][/h3]

[h3][b]Game End Cutscene:[/b][/h3]
- Included a cinematic cutscene to enhance storytelling.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.content:
We are participating in Steam Next Fest, which will start on February 6 and last 7 days!

We have great new features and content planned for the game, and some are already implemented, we have updated our demo to better show our games full potential to get ready for Steam Next Fest, check out our game and keep giving us your feedback!

Thank you for your continuing support.
